Preserve her exact brown double buns with long twin tails, red ribbons, ornate gold and pale turquoise hair ornaments, amber eyes, red jeweled forehead ornament, red/white/gold layered costume, gold trim and waist beads, red/gold boots, and the same long dark-shaft crimson gold spear with red tassels. Identity takes priority. Match original chibi proportion and costume faithfully. Body center x=512, ground contact y=942 on a 1024 canvas; standing body about 700 pixels from head/buns to foot, max full equipment extent inside x=65..960 and y=45..952. Neither a leap, run, kick, attack, crossed legs nor standing. Make clean leg articulation and genuine weight-bearing contact with a small natural counter-swing of hair and sleeves. Do not reproduce the lifted-knee airborne portrait pose. Highest available visual finish. No purple/magenta rim, no colored matte. Image 3 is the current front walking reference: preserve precisely this rendering, character dimensions, outfit and spear grip while drawing the specified DIFFERENT leg pose from scratch. This pose comes immediately after Image 3 phase01. Left boot flattens and knee softly bends; right heel rolls up, rather than lifting the whole right leg. Preserve head size and exact camera.
